globalApis.name: Wikidata QLever SPARQL Engine
globalApis.purpose: Harvests statutory heritage designations (P1435), national registry IDs across 60+ sovereign registers, physical conservation status (P5816), multi-year visitor attendance (P1174), inception dates (P571), architectural style/material/patronage, and coordinates — strictly filtered to human-built structures.

globalApis.name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre & Culture DataHub APIs
globalApis.purpose: Provides official World Heritage Cultural inscriptions & Danger listings (whc001, criteria i–vi only), audited international cultural assistance grants (prj001), and SDG 11.4.1 per-capita public cultural heritage expenditure (uis002).

globalApis.name: 59+ Sovereign National Heritage Registry & Open-Data Portals
globalApis.endpoint: Country-specific statutory APIs (ASI, POP Base Mérimée, NHLE, NRHP, ICCD, BIC, RCE, Bunkachō, NCHA Guobao, SAHRA, IPHAN, etc.)
globalApis.purpose: Cross-validates statutory monument IDs within sovereign borders, links each monument to its legal act and recognizing ministry, and supplies official domestic conservation budgets & audited ticket compendia.

globalApis.name: Multilateral & Philanthropic Conservation Grant Registries
globalApis.endpoint: ALIPH Foundation · U.S. Ambassadors Fund (AFCP) · World Monuments Fund · Aga Khan Trust for Culture · IMF COFOG (GF0802)
globalApis.purpose: Tracks active emergency stabilization and conservation grants for conflict-, disaster-, and climate-threatened monuments, plus general government cultural expenditure where ministry line-items are unpublished.

globalApis.name: Wikimedia Commons MediaWiki API & Wikipedia REST API v1
globalApis.purpose: Retrieves open-licensed ground photography, multi-image monument galleries, and scholarly historical summaries while exposing photographic and archival documentation gaps where absent.
